fullPassage: I am Amanda Clark, the school club director, and I am writing to you about our school clubs. Over the last few semesters, there have been requests for more diverse school clubs. For this reason, the school decided to expand the number of clubs for extracurricular activities. This provides students with an opportunity to make additional clubs. Students can make any type of club based on their various interests, such as hip-hop, K-pop dancing, or coding. Therefore, I am encouraging you to submit a proposal for a new club that you would like to create. Please turn this in to my office by the end of this week. I look forward to seeing your great ideas.

questions.passage:
(A) Students can make any type of club based on their various interests, such as hip-hop, K-pop dancing, or coding. Therefore, I am encouraging you to submit a proposal for a new club that you would like to create.

(B) I am Amanda Clark, the school club director, and I am writing to you about our school clubs. Over the last few semesters, there have been requests for more diverse school clubs.

(C) For this reason, the school decided to expand the number of clubs for extracurricular activities. This provides students with an opportunity to make additional clubs.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: 원문 전체 흐름: 자기소개+배경(B) → 확대 결정+기회(C) → 구체적 내용+권유(A)
det.correct: ③ (B)-(C)-(A): 자기소개/배경 → 결정 → 구체적 안내 순서.
wrongs: ① (A)부터 시작하면 맥락 없이 구체적 내용이 먼저 옴
② (C)부터 시작하면 'For this reason'의 이유가 없음
det.tip: 순서배열: 지시어(This, For this reason)와 연결어(Therefore)로 흐름 파악

det.correct: (b) had been → have been: 'Over the last few semesters'는 현재완료 시간 표현.
det.tip: Over the last ~ → 현재완료(have p.p.) 필수. 과거완료(had p.p.)는 과거 이전 시점

questions.passage: I am Amanda Clark, the school club director, and I am writing to you about our school clubs. Over the last few semesters, there have been requests for more diverse school clubs. For this reason, the school decided to expand the number of clubs for extracurricular activities. This provides students with an opportunity to make additional clubs. Students can make any type of club based on their various interests, such as hip-hop, K-pop dancing, or coding. Therefore, I am encouraging you to submit a proposal for a new club that you would like to create. Please turn this in to my office by the end of this week. I look forward to seeing your great ideas.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸을 채우시오.

"이것을 이번 주 말까지 제 사무실로 제출해 주세요."

Please turn this in to my office by the __________ of this week.

det.ref:
[원문] by the end of this week
[해석] 이번 주 말까지
